_comment: Per-spawn preamble payload ceiling (road-to-cache-economy Phase 3), unblocked by C-3 measuring 38.0% against a 15% bar. This is a RATCHET, not the roadmap's literal candidate numbers: those (median 40k / p95 50k) were anchored to an upstream ~37k baseline, while this package's own deterministic in-repo payload is ~102.5k tokens — a hard 40k gate would be red on the day it lands and would teach the reader to ignore it. The ratchet fails on GROWTH instead, so the number can only walk down, and the 40k/50k target stays recorded as the destination. Only the deterministic, in-repo buckets are gated: user-scope rules depend on what the developer happens to have installed globally and are therefore not CI-checkable.

metric.basis: chars/4 token estimate over the projected tree, produced by src/scripts/preamble_byte_census.ts
excluded_buckets: tool definitions + dispatch prompt — no local source carries the request payload; the census reports it as an explicit residual

baseline_history.why: free tightening: the measured tree came in 79 tok under the registered baseline, so the ratchet walks down to meet it. Not a claimed reduction — nothing was optimised; the point of a ratchet is that a lower measurement becomes the new ceiling instead of becoming unused headroom.

target_tokens._comment: The roadmap's candidate numbers, kept as the destination. Reaching them needs reductions this package has not built yet; scope-dedup (C-3) removes a redundant COPY at the consumer, it does not shrink the suite itself.

reference_measurements.c3_condition: FIXTURE-ONLY as of 2026-07-31: the 38% was measured on a byte-identical two-scope fixture, and that condition is currently unreachable for every consumer because install.ts:2723/2725 stamp package:/source_path: into every installed rule while the in-repo projection stamps nothing. Aligning versions yields 0/110 twins, not 110/110. The figure is the mechanism's ceiling, NOT a realised saving, and this baseline therefore assumes no dedup. Reachability is the subject of road-to-dedup-reachability; run measure_scope_dedup for the live split.
reference_measurements._comment: The measured median comes from Claude Code transcripts (deduped by message.id + requestId) and is context for the ratchet, never the gated number — it moves with the developer's own session history.
